name: Manbiki Shoujo Ryoujoku Shiiku ~Mesuniku Omocha no Kankin Seikatsu~
original_name: 万引き少女 陵辱飼育 ～牝肉玩具の監禁性活～
source:
It is an evening in July, at the start of the summer break. A timid girl tries to lift a convenience store on the road between the school and the station, urged strongly by one of her friends.

A security camera catches her in the act.
The trembling girl is offered a choice.

Shall we go to the police? Or maybe... Which will it be?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ035908.html]DLsite English[/url]]
